chunks: And the shin shall be bound to the shin
ai.seo_question: What does the binding of the shin signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Qaf: 40) is often linked with the preceding verse regarding the 'stripping' of garments, symbolizing the removal of worldly pretenses and the exposure of the soul's true state before God. Scholars such as Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni interpret the binding of the shins as a physical manifestation of the inability to flee or escape divine judgment, emphasizing the helplessness of the disbelievers on that Day.
